[Questions, comments, and reports about any tool on this site.]{.lead-line}

## Discussion forum

The discussion forum for all MATRIX software is hosted on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/MATRIX-Research-Lab/software/discussions), with one category per method. A GitHub account is required to post.

## Bug reports

Report a reproducible error in the repository of the corresponding package.

| Software | Issue tracker |
|---|---|
| ANCOMBC (R): ANCOM-BC, ANCOM-BC2, SECOM | [FrederickHuangLin/ANCOMBC](https://github.com/FrederickHuangLin/ANCOMBC/issues) |
| scikit-bio (Python): ANCOM-BC, ANCOM-BC2 | [scikit-bio/scikit-bio](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/issues) |
| q2-composition (QIIME 2) | [QIIME 2 Forum](https://forum.qiime2.org/) |
| MetVAE (Python) | [FrederickHuangLin/MetVAE-PyPI](https://github.com/FrederickHuangLin/MetVAE-PyPI/issues) |

## Platform support sites

- [Bioconductor Support](https://support.bioconductor.org/tag/ANCOMBC/) for questions about the ANCOMBC R package.
- [QIIME 2 Forum](https://forum.qiime2.org/) for questions about the QIIME 2 plugin.
